description: DynamicTrees JSON file to define a fruit and its properties

item_stack.description: The item the fruit/pod represents. It will select this item when middle-clicked."type": Allows for custom behavior beyond these properties. There are no options by default, but more can be added by addons.

max_age.description: The maximum age value for the block.

block_shapes.description: A list of the shapes for the hitbox of each stage of growth. For more info go to this section.

can_bone_meal.description: Whether the fruit or pod will grow when bone-mealed.

growth_chance.description: Chance each tick for the fruit to grow to the next stage.

season_offset.description: [When a season mod is installed] The offset from summer that the fruit is on season.

flower_hold_period_length.description: [When a season mod is installed] The length of time in seasons that the fruit/pod won't grow past the flower stage (stage 0) right before the period when its on season to harvest.

min_production_factor.description: [When a season mod is installed] The minimum production factor value that the fruit can survive at. If the factor dips below this threshold the fruit/pod will wither away and disappear. This happens on the opposite season of its harvest season. A lower value means it lasts longer.

mature_action.description: A custom action that the block can perform when maturing. This requires code as none are defined by default.

fraction.description: How many units per block are used to define the next parameters

radius.description: The radius of the fruit box

height.description: The height of the fruit box

stem_length.description: The distance from the bottom of the block on top to the top of the box
